program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time, seed, state }) { const u = inputs.launchSpeed; const g = inputs.gravity; const tMax = 2 * u / g; const tTop = u / g; const tClamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(time, tMax)); const tossedVelocity = u - g * tClamped; const tossedAcceleration = -g; const tossedHeight = u * tClamped - 0.5 * g * tClamped * tClamped; let dropVelocity = 0; let dropAcceleration = 0; let dropHeight = tossedHeight >= (u*u)/(2*g) ? tossedHeight : (u*u)/(2*g); if (tClamped >= tTop) { const dt = tClamped - tTop; dropVelocity = -g * dt; dropAcceleration = -g; dropHeight = (u*u)/(2*g) - 0.5 * g * dt * dt; } else { dropHeight = (u*u)/(2*g); dropVelocity = 0; dropAcceleration = 0; } const isAtTop = Math.abs(tClamped - tTop) < 0.05; const gateOpen = tClamped >= tTop; let tossState = "At launch"; if (tClamped > 0.05 && tClamped < tTop - 0.05) tossState = "Rising"; else if (isAtTop) tossState = "At the top"; else if (tClamped > tTop + 0.05 && tossedHeight > 0.05) tossState = "Falling"; else if (tClamped >= tMax - 0.05) tossState = "At launch height"; let dropState = "Held in place"; if (isAtTop) dropState = "Just released"; else if (tClamped > tTop + 0.05 && dropHeight > 0.05) dropState = "Falling together"; else if (tClamped >= tMax - 0.05) dropState = "At launch height"; const pxScale = 120; const baseY = 360; const tossX = 200; const dropX = 440; const yToScreen = (h) => baseY - h * pxScale; const ballTossY = yToScreen(tossedHeight); const ballDropY = yToScreen(dropHeight); let objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 50, y: 50, w: 260, h: 340, title: "Toss lane", state: tossState, id: "lane.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 330, y: 50, w: 260, h: 340, title: "Drop lane", state: dropState, id: "lane.drop" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.toss", { x: tossX, y: baseY, length: 260, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.drop", { x: dropX, y: baseY, length: 260, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(...sdk.gate("gate", dropX, yToScreen((u*u)/(2*g)), { open: gateOpen, label: "Apex Gate" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", tossX, ballTossY, 24, { role: "output" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.drop", dropX, ballDropY, 24, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.toss", { x: tossX - 16, y: ballTossY }, { value: tossedVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.toss", { x: tossX + 16, y: ballTossY }, { value: tossedAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 10, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.drop", { x: dropX - 16, y: ballDropY }, { value: dropVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.drop", { x: dropX + 16, y: ballDropY }, { value: dropAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 10, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(tossX + 35, ballTossY - 20, ["v: " + tossedVelocity.toFixed(2) + " m/s", "a: " + tossedAcceleration.toFixed(2) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(dropX + 35, ballDropY - 20, ["v: " + dropVelocity.toFixed(2) + " m/s", "a: " + dropAcceleration.toFixed(2) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.drop" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{ id: "tossedVelocity", value: tossedVelocity }, { id: "tossedAcceleration", value: tossedAcceleration }, { id: "dropVelocity", value: dropVelocity }, { id: "dropAcceleration", value: dropAcceleration }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: u, gravity: g, apexTime: tTop, apexHeight: (u*u)/(2*g), tossedVelocity, tossedAcceleration, tossedHeight, dropVelocity, dropAcceleration, dropHeight } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top of a toss, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps pulling at a = -g. A dropped ball released then falls identically.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball. Velocity and acceleration vectors display numerical readouts at each instant.
assumptions: No air resistance, uniform gravity, vertical motion only.
manifest.instructions: Press Play to start the motion or use the scrubber to inspect individual instants around the top.
